tools.name: gdrive_copy_file
tools.description: Creates a copy of a file

name.description: Name for the copied file. If not specified, uses "Copy of [original name]"

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the parent folder for the copy. If not specified, copies to same location

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_create_folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder in Google Drive

name.description: Name of the folder to create

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the parent folder. If not specified, creates in root folder

starred.description: Whether to star the folder (default: false)

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_delete_file
tools.description: Permanently deletes a file from Google Drive (bypasses trash)

file_id.description: File or folder ID to delete permanently

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_download_file
tools.description: Downloads a file from Google Drive (returns base64 encoded content)

mime_type.description: For Google Workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides), specify export MIME type (e.g., "application/pdf", "text/plain", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet")

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_export_file
tools.description: Exports a Google Workspace document (Docs, Sheets, Slides) to a different format

file_id.description: Google Workspace file ID to export

mime_type.description: Export MIME type (e.g., "application/pdf", "text/plain" for Docs, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" for Sheets)

tools.name: gdrive_get_file
tools.description: Gets metadata for a specific file or folder by ID

fields.description: Specific fields to retrieve (e.g., "id,name,mimeType,size,owners,permissions"). If not specified, returns all fields

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_list_files
tools.description: Lists files and folders in Google Drive with optional filtering and pagination

query.description: Search query using Google Drive query syntax (e.g., "name contains 'report'", "mimeType = 'image/jpeg'", "'parent_folder_id' in parents")

max_results.description: Maximum number of files to return (default: 10, max: 1000)

page_token.description: Page token for pagination to get next page of results

order_by.description: Sort order (e.g., "folder,modifiedTime desc,name"). Options: createdTime, folder, modifiedByMeTime, modifiedTime, name, quotaBytesUsed, recency, sharedWithMeTime, starred, viewedByMeTime

folder_id.description: List files only in this folder (folder ID). If not specified, lists from root or uses query

include_trashed.description: Include trashed files in results (default: false)

spaces.description: Comma-separated list of spaces to query (drive, appDataFolder, photos)

fields.description: Fields to include in response (e.g., "files(id,name,mimeType,size,createdTime)"). If not specified, returns all fields

supports_all_drives.description: Include items from all drives (including shared drives) (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_list_permissions
tools.description: Lists all permissions for a file or folder

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_remove_permission
tools.description: Removes a permission from a file or folder

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_search_files
tools.description: Searches for files using Google Drive query syntax (convenience wrapper for gdrive_list_files with search focus)

query.description: Search query using Drive query syntax (e.g., "name contains 'report' and mimeType contains 'pdf'", "modifiedTime > '2024-01-01T00:00:00'")

supports_all_drives.description: Include items from all drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_share_file
tools.description: Creates a permission to share a file or folder with a user or make it publicly accessible

file_id.description: File or folder ID to share

role.description: Permission role (owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, reader)

type.description: Type of grantee (user, group, domain, anyone for public)

email_address.description: Email address of user or group (required when type is user or group)

domain.description: Domain name (required when type is domain)

send_notification_email.description: Whether to send notification email to the recipient (default: true)

email_message.description: Custom message to include in notification email

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_trash_file
tools.description: Moves a file to trash (can be restored later)

file_id.description: File or folder ID to move to trash

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

content.description: New file content (base64 encoded). If provided, updates file content

mime_type.description: New MIME type (required if updating content)

trashed.description: Whether the file is in trash

add_parents.description: Array of parent folder IDs to add

remove_parents.description: Array of parent folder IDs to remove

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)

tools.name: gdrive_upload_file
tools.description: Uploads a file to Google Drive

name.description: Name of the file to create

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the parent folder. If not specified, uploads to root folder

starred.description: Whether to star the file (default: false)

supports_all_drives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives (default: false)
